subject: Clarify fractional billing after mid-cycle seat increase
messages:
From: Alexa Palmer <alexa.palmer@steadytech.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Clarify fractional billing after mid-cycle seat increase

Hi Marcus / Grace,

Hope you're well — quick billing question. We increased our seat count from 12 -> 20 on 2026-08-18 and noticed a small "fractional charge" on the August invoice (line description: "partial-period seats"). The amount is larger than I expected and the VAT line doesn't clearly show how the proration was applied.

Can you share the calculation used for the partial-month charge and confirm whether the VAT was applied to the prorated amount or to the full monthly rate? Our finance group needs an updated invoice that separates the prorated base, VAT, and the applied credit (if any) so we can book it against PO STDY-7782.

PO number: STDY-7782 (attached)
VAT ID: GB245678912

Appreciate a quick breakdown — we have an internal close coming Friday.

Thanks,
Alexa Palmer
Head of Ops, SteadyTech Inc.
alexa.palmer@steadytech.io
finance@steadytech.io

Attachment: STDY-PO-7782.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alexa Palmer <alexa.palmer@steadytech.io>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify fractional billing after mid-cycle seat increase

Hi Alexa — thanks for the details and the PO. Sorry for the frustration.

Short answer: we prorate on a per-seat, per-day basis using the monthly list price, then aggregate the fractional charge and apply VAT to the prorated subtotal. Any full-month credits from seat reductions would appear separately.

I'll loop in finance (Laura) to produce a line-by-line reissued invoice that shows:
- per-seat daily rate used for the proration
- days charged at each seat tier (pre/post change)
- subtotal of prorated charge
- VAT applied (rate shown)
- any credit or rounding adjustments

Laura — could you use the values below to create the updated invoice and attach a short spreadsheet showing the math? I put together a quick proforma that should help (attached). If you need the exact account-level pricing tier, it is the "team-standard-2026" plan; unit price = USD 1,200 / seat / month.

Alexa — can you confirm whether you want the invoice reissued as: (A) a corrected August invoice showing the prorated line and VAT breakdown, or (B) an interim standalone invoice for the prorated seat increase that references the August billing period? Option A is cleaner for bookkeeping but sometimes procurement prefers B for PO matching.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: proforma_proration.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Alexa Palmer <alexa.palmer@steadytech.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify fractional billing after mid-cycle seat increase

Thanks Marcus — option (A) would be best for our AP team; please reissue the August invoice showing the prorated seat increase and VAT breakdown.

Confirming VAT ID again: GB245678912
PO attached for matching: STDY-PO-7782.pdf

One more ask: can you include a short human-readable note that says "Charge is for 8 additional seats added 2026-08-18 — prorated for 13 days in August" so our entry clerk can match it to the PO? That will speed reconciliation.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alexa

Attachment: STDY-PO-7782.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alexa Palmer <alexa.palmer@steadytech.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Reissued invoice and proration detail (SteadyTech)

Hi Alexa — attaching the reissued invoice and a short CSV-style breakdown for your AP team. Summary below: 

Computation summary:
- Plan: team-standard-2026 | unit = $1,200 / seat / month
- Original seats (Aug 1–Aug 17): 12 seats for 17 days -> charge = 12 * (1,200 / 31) * 17 = $7,887.10
- Increased seats (Aug 18–Aug 31): 20 seats for 13 days -> charge = 20 * (1,200 / 31) * 13 = $10,064.52
- Prorated incremental charge (difference): $10,064.52 + $7,887.10 - (12 * 1,200) = $... (see attached breakdown)
- VAT (20% GB): applied to prorated subtotal as requested; VAT amount and tax rate included on invoice
- Rounding/adjustment: small rounding credit of $0.38 applied to match ledger formatting

We reissued the August invoice (INV-RED-20260901-STEADY.pdf) with the human-readable note you requested and split lines for pre/post-change seat counts. The invoice references PO STDY-7782. If the AP system requires a standalone interim invoice instead, let me know and we can issue one that references August but is separate.

Attachment: INV-RED-20260901-STEADY.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks — hope this fixes the reconciliation.

Regards,
